question_design: One source-first, mostly abstract-based English query per local PDF; expected answers and citation entailment still need independent human review.
interpretation: Initial retrieval baseline only. On these 45 English source-first questions, hybrid improves R@10 and nDCG@10 over dense under paired intervals, while BM25 is much faster and competitive. The overlap diagnostic warns that query wording may favor non-gold passages from the same paper. This is not Hindi-query, answer-quality, or citation-faithfulness evidence; question and claim-to-passage review is pending.
latency_note: Warm p50/p95 after three warm-up queries; excludes model initialization. Absolute timings depend on local CPU hardware.
interval_note: Paired bootstrap intervals compare each candidate with dense on the same 45 questions. Not every interval excludes zero.
